description: TinySoundFont v0.9 with the hardening patch and the quality engine defaults (Catmull-Rom interpolation, low-pass ramping, SF2 modulators, chorus/reverb sends, SF3 pad fix, single-owner playback wrapper) plus the KANTA local `sampleTotal` delta for post-decode region bounds; drop-in replacement for apps/android/app/src/main/cpp/vendor/. stb_vorbis.c enables SF3/Ogg banks. Compiled warning-clean under -Wall -Wextra -Werror on 64-bit hosts. See the kanta-vendor-a272fe30 release.

stbVorbis.license: MIT or public domain (dual, see file header)
stbVorbis.note: Ogg Vorbis decoder that enables SF3/Ogg banks; compiled inside soundfont.c behind STB_VORBIS_INCLUDE_STB_VORBIS_H.

localDelta.tsf.h: Added `unsigned int sampleTotal` to `struct tsf` and set it after `tsf_load_samples` so the native wrapper can bound decoded regions against the real post-decode frame count (SF3/Ogg banks expand far beyond their on-disk size). The odd-sized smpl pad handling is the fork revision's own fix.
localDelta.note: vendor/tsf.h hashes above reflect the KANTA local delta; the fork and upstream revision fields record the unmodified base.
